summary: Happy City Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Mr. Ho Wai Alan Chung, effective July 31, 2026, who also stepped down as chair of the nominating committee and as a member of audit and compensation committees. The resignation was stated to be for pursuing other professional business, not due to any disagreement with the company. No special deal terms are involved. The board will consist of six directors post-resignation, with Mr. Liu Sicheng assuming the nominating committee chair. This is a routine board change, not a forced departure; watch for any subsequent governance disclosures.
